actions.planHelp: Dry-run the sample grid first, review the planned dataset id, then build. Safer for new windows.

plan.title: Plan training dataset
plan.summary: Dry-run the sample grid; no artifact or ledger row is written.
plan.reviewSummary: Review the dry-run result, then build reusing this dataset id.

build.title: Build training dataset
build.summary: Plan and materialize the PIT dataset (may take minutes).

selector.prefillOrphan: Dataset {id} is no longer trainable; select another.

form.summary: Pick a frozen runtime-config version and a model spec, then bound the PIT window.
form.horizonsHelp: Comma-separated positive integers (one label column per horizon).
form.purposeHelp: Training datasets feed model training; Calibration datasets are independent held-out splits for probability calibrator fitting (must be disjoint + embargoed from training data).
form.incomplete: Fill in model spec, version, window, and at least one horizon.

create.title: New model spec
create.summary: A model spec is the root of the offline research lifecycle: declare the model family, prediction horizon, and feature/label schema versions the downstream dataset build and training runs bind to. Created as a draft.
create.name: Name
create.specJsonHelp: Optional free-form JSON (authoring notes, tuning intent); defaults to an empty object.
create.incomplete: Provide a name; prediction horizon must be >= 1.
create.duplicateName: Name "{name}" already exists — choose another or open the existing spec.

detail.title: Model spec details
detail.nextStepsHelp: After authoring a spec, build a training dataset, then train a model version.

featureRequirements.genericPlaceholder: Select features required for every candidate
featureRequirements.genericHelp: Applied to all markets when no category-specific model is routed. Names must exist in the governed feature schema.
featureRequirements.categoryPlaceholder: Select features required for this category route
featureRequirements.categoryHelp: Additive to generic requirements when a category pointer is configured in runtime config.

train.title: Train model
train.summary: Train a candidate version from a frozen dataset.

train.classicalObjectiveHint: Classical families train pointwise baselines; the LTR research.training snapshot does not apply.
train.objectiveProxyHint: Tail/turnover use a TopN score-ranked equal-weight pseudo portfolio (optimization proxy ≠ backtest USD allocations).
train.predictionHorizonHelp: Frozen into the trained artifact and used online for horizon score multiplier and suggested_horizon_secs. Not a runtime-config field — set per training run (default 86400 = 24h).

train.noPermission: You lack permission to train models (materialization:create).
train.modalUnavailable: The train form is not ready yet; try again in a moment.

backtest.title: Run backtest
backtest.summary: Replay the model over a frozen dataset (PIT only).

backtest.incomplete: Fill in the dataset and version.

rollback.title: Rollback model
rollback.summary: Restore retired model version {id} to Published.

bindCalibration.title: Bind calibrator
bindCalibration.summary: Create a new candidate model version whose return model is calibrated from the selected artifact.

register.title: Register enabled factors
register.summary: Idempotently register the enabled factor set (from the active runtime config) as Draft, preserving the status of already-registered definitions. This is the first bootstrap step toward a working live report.

publishBatch.title: Publish factors
publishBatch.summary: Publish {count} draft factor definitions in one action.
publishBatch.empty: No draft factor definitions to publish.

collinearity.title: Factor Collinearity
collinearity.hint: Pairwise Spearman rank correlation across recent factor values. Highly correlated factors carry redundant signal.

collinearity.clean: No factor pair exceeds the correlation threshold.
collinearity.violationsTitle: {count} collinear factor pair(s) exceed the threshold

empty.description: No calibration artifacts yet. Fit a bias table or model-score calibrator to start the calibration loop.

fitBiasTable.title: Fit bias table
fitBiasTable.summary: Fit a favorite-longshot bias table over the trailing {days} days. Fails closed (no artifact) when the settlement spine is too thin.

fitCalibrator.title: Fit model calibrator
fitCalibrator.summary: Fit a held-out probability calibrator for a candidate model version using an independent calibration dataset.
fitCalibrator.validation: Select a model version and calibration dataset.

preflight.disjointFail: Overlaps an existing training dataset — the fit will be rejected
preflight.embargoFail: Starts before the required embargo gap — the fit will be rejected
preflight.checkFailed: Could not run the preflight check (the fit will still be validated server-side on submit)

activate.title: Activate bias table
activate.summary: Stage a runtime-config version pinning this market-price bias artifact as the favorite-longshot source. Activate that version from the runtime-config console to make it live.
activate.feedback: Config version staged — activate it in runtime config

detail.title: Calibration artifact
detail.reliabilityHint: Predicted vs empirical frequency by calibrated-probability bucket (diagonal = perfect calibration); vertical bars are the Wilson confidence interval.
detail.reliabilityAria: Reliability diagram over {binCount} calibration bins totaling {sampleCount} samples. Predicted probability ranges from {predictedMin} to {predictedMax}; empirical frequency ranges from {empiricalMin} to {empiricalMax}. The dashed diagonal marks perfect calibration.

resolve.title: Resolve market linkages
resolve.summary: Re-run the offline linkage resolver for every category-mapped market whose metadata changed. Appends new ledger rows; never mutates history.
resolve.feedback: Resolver pass complete — examined {examined}, appended {appended}, unchanged {unchanged}, resolved {resolved}, unresolved {unresolved}

resolveOne.title: Resolve market linkage
resolveOne.summary: Re-run the offline linkage resolver for market {marketId} if its metadata or ruleset changed. Appends a new ledger row; never mutates history.

override.title: Override market linkage
override.supersedeWarning: This linkage already has a resolved/overridden binding. Submitting appends a new resolver_tier=override row that supersedes it going forward — the prior binding stays in history, never deleted.
override.summary: Audited operator override for market {marketId}. Appends a resolver_tier=override ledger row; history is never mutated.
override.instrumentKeyHint: Canonical feature-source instrument key — always the Binance kline key for the selected asset, per the frozen resolver ruleset, regardless of which oracle settles the market. Auto-derived; not independently editable.
override.evidenceHint: An override is a human decision, not text-extracted — but every load-bearing identity field below still requires a literal citation copied from the market's real metadata. It is checked byte-exact server-side; a fabricated or paraphrased citation is rejected.
override.evidenceTextPlaceholder: Paste the exact text as it appears in the source field

validation.referenceAtRequired: Reference time is required for up/down markets.
validation.strikeRequired: Strike is required for above/below markets.
validation.betweenHiRequired: Upper bound is required for between markets.
validation.assetEvidenceRequired: A literal citation for the asset is required.
validation.oracleEvidenceRequired: A literal citation for the resolution oracle is required.
validation.strikeEvidenceRequired: A literal citation for the strike is required.

grounding.title: Grounding proof (field → source → span)
grounding.empty: No grounding spans (operator override — see audit above).

basisAlerts.title: Basis cross-check alerts

basisAlerts.notApplicable: Basis cross-check does not apply — settlement oracle is not Chainlink Data Streams.

acknowledge.summary: Mark this basis-cross-check exceedance for market {marketId} as triaged. Records who and when on the alert row; never mutates the linkage ledger.

verdict.mixed: Mixed result — rank IC and realized PnL disagree on direction.
